resolution: Audited cart application sources and separated native ReactJIT networking from loopback bridges and child-process networking. Four app roots directly issue non-loopback HTTP through the framework network hooks: cart/app, cart/browser, cart/image-gen, and cart/hmsc-int. The active cart/editor has no direct internet call sites. cart/browse-mvp.tsx and cart/research-lab.tsx talk only to a localhost-controlled Firefox process; cart/t3code can run git clone; assistant/CLI carts generally delegate vendor traffic to spawned processes, so those do not exercise the framework socket implementation.
